stage_name_zh: 阶段 3：逻辑写作、消融对比与六级/雅思托福高分论证（Day 51–75）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G005】词形变化、词缀构词与词性语法槽位匹配（名、动、形、副）；【G010】不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP013】严辨统计相关与因果机制（Correlation vs. Causality & Confounding），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 词形变化、词缀构词与词性语法槽位匹配（名、动、形、副）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握学术词族与常见词缀（-able, -cy, -ify, -ise/-ize, -ism/-ist, -less, anti-, co-, il-/im-/in-/ir-, multi-, over-, pre-, post-）的转换，确保名词充当主宾表、动词充当谓语、形容词修饰名词或作表语、副词修饰动词/形容词/全句。
rules: 严禁词性混填：accurate (adj.) / accuracy (n.) / accurately (adv.)；analyse (v.) / analysis (n., 复数 analyses) / analytical (adj.)；vary (v.) / variable (n./adj.) / variation (n.)。
警惕词缀语义陷阱：predictable 表示“可预测的”而非“已被预测的”；successive 表示“连续相继的”而非“成功的（successful）”；priceless/meaningless 语义受语境限定；bi-monthly 有歧义，学术写作应改写为 every two months 或 twice a month。
英美拼写（analyse/analyze, behaviour/behavior, parametrisation/parameterization）在同一篇文稿中必须统一。
examples: Accurate records are essential for checking the analysis.
Attendance increased in three successive years.
The appendix clarifies the coding procedure.
common_errors: 形容词与名词混用：*assess the accurate of measurements（应为 accuracy）。
混淆同根异义派生词：把 successive（连续的）误作 successful（成功的），把stationary（平稳的）误拼为 stationery（文具）。

grammar_instruction.name: 不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 动词后接不定式（to do）还是动名词（doing）取决于动词配价规约；同时注意 warrant, facilitate, advocate, involve, consider, anticipate 等核心学术动词的补足语限制。
rules: 接动名词（doing）或名词、不接不定式的典型动词：consider, involve, advocate, anticipate, recommend, suggest, warrant（warrant further investigation / warrant revising），facilitate（facilitate comparison，严禁写 *facilitate sb to do）。
接不定式（to do）的典型动词：aim, attempt, tend, seek, intend, resolve, enable sb to do, allow sb to do, force sb to do, oblige sb to do。
examples: The report advocates providing clearer information to applicants.
The procedure involves checking every record twice.
A common reporting format can facilitate comparison across studies.
common_errors: 误用不定式：*warrant to conclude / *facilitate researchers to compare / *advocate to provide / *involve to check。

grammar_instruction.name: 限制性/非限制性定语从句与“介词 + which/whom”精确修饰
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 定语从句是构建精确后置定语、避免中式前置长定语的核心工具。必须严格区分限制性（无逗号，界定子集）与非限制性（有逗号，补充评注，不可用 that），并掌握介词前置结构。
rules: 限制性定语从句缩窄先行词范围：The analogy breaks down where the two systems differ in the feature on which the comparison depends。
介词 + which 结构由从句动词或先行词搭配决定：the age at which, the point at which, the rate at which, the extent to which, a protocol by means of which, the assumptions on which the model rests。
examples: We devised a protocol by means of which records could be checked.
The study examines the degree to which access varies by region.
Before accepting an inference, we check the information on which it depends.
common_errors: 非限制性定语从句逗号后误用 that。
介词 + which 遗漏固定介词：*the extent which the findings generalise（漏掉 to）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 严辨统计相关与因果机制（Correlation vs. Causality & Confounding）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Although [Variable X] correlates with [Outcome Y], predictive accuracy alone cannot establish causality due to potential unmeasured confounding.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习可解释性、医疗/社会科学数据分析，严格划清相关与因果的界限。
examples: A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.
Unmeasured confounding may bias an estimated treatment effect.
common_errors: 将特征重要性或滞后相关性直接称为因果作用。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。
